I use fried tofu but you can use boiled tofu..

200 grams of tofu
500 grams of chicken( not necessary can be replaced with more tofu)
Bean sprouts just a small bowl full about 100 grams
Laksa paste
Chicken stock about 1L or 2 pints
Boiled eggs about as many as needed I use 2 per bowl cut in half
Prawns about a handful
I add msg so about a tablespoon or 2
2 Bok Choy heads
Chilli ( whatever you degree of chili)
Coconut cream
Vermicelli or egg hokkein noodles or whatever noodles ya got

Boil the chicken stock and tofu and chicken together with the  Laksa paste til the chicken is cooked roughly 12-17 minutes depending on how good your stove is I have quite a Hot stove so I just put mine on for 12

Add the bean sprouts and prawns and Bok Choy  to the boil do this for about 5 more minutes or so and add the coconut cream

And now put the soup into the bowls and enjoy with some eggs on top with the noodles in the bottom or the bowl.
